deviations_from_card: (1) Case 6 not met as written: <= 0.05 at EVERY segment midpoint between her window and Main is not reachable under the 30 Hz mirror cap - after: 11 of 55 midpoints over (max 0.118, mean 0.028); before: 10 of 55 (max 0.126). The gap is a 3-frame vowel after a jump in level that the mirror sees one frame late. Measured alternatives: every viseme change mirrored at once -> 1 of 55 over at 32.7 signals/s (loosens ADR 0027's cap, owner call, not built); closure onset+offset -> 7-9 of 55. Committed instead: every closure midpoint agrees within 0.05 and no midpoint exceeds 0.15 (red before: PP at frame 166 0.083), plus an it.todo for the full case. (2) The driver's target with a viseme is mouthTarget(viseme, level) - the producer's rule on the signal, matching case 3's literal wording - rather than tracking signal.open; without a viseme it follows signal.open (case 7). Following open with a viseme measured worse on case 6 (max 0.172). Driver opening tau kept at 35 ms (the previous driver value; 22 ms measured 13/55 over), closing 12 ms. (3) Case 2's neighbours widened from 16 ms to 24 ms so the case can be red before (16 ms neighbours have nothing to spare, so nothing changes); the card's 16 ms variant is kept in the same test as an unchanged-guard. (4) Grew the write set by one coupled doc: avatar/types.ts FaceSignal.open comment (it described the old driver rule). (5) Fixtures now carry open = mouthTarget(viseme, level) so the preview harness and perf fixture still open the mouth.
